stations.title: Odile
stations.say: Fetch the list for sailing S2.
stations.note: Then she cancels it for weather.

stations.title: Harbour server
stations.note: Shared by every boat on the coast.

stations.title: Your code
stations.gap: No retry, no way to stop

captions: Odile's tablet fetches the passenger list for sailing S2 from a busy harbour server.
Odile cancels S2 for weather, but the tablet keeps retrying.
You write the retry and a sleep you can cancel, in three tasks.
Now busy calls wait longer each time, and S2 stops the moment it is cancelled.
Try again politely, and nothing runs after you say stop.
